scope: Root-authored analytic development labels. No external novelty or usefulness labels.

case-01.reason: Mean scales by 2 and variance by 4, so N(2x)=N(x).

case-02.reason: N(2x)=(x-mean(x))/sqrt(var(x)+1/4), different from epsilon 1 for nonconstant x.

case-03.reason: Product rule gives dX=-KX-XK^T; F=0 and its exact flow is identity.

case-04.reason: Ito's product rule adds sigma^2 I; its propagated integral is positive definite for t>0 and sigma nonzero.

case-05.reason: Both exact reconstruction and output-changing reconstruction are consistent; the second layer could also erase differences.

case-06.reason: Source theorem cannot establish transfer outside its assumptions, but does not disprove it. Kernel normalization and target theory are unknown.
